facts.claim: Manual research on maps and search is free and uncovers many local businesses, especially those that appear on Google Maps but have no website.
facts.title: How to Find Leads in India: Methods Compared LeadsMint

facts.claim: The downside of manual map research is the time it takes, because nothing is recorded and repeated searches return the same businesses.

facts.claim: Lead‑finder software such as LeadsMint lets you search for a business type within a radius of 1 to 50 km, review results for free, unlock leads for a credit, and manage them in a CRM, but it only shows businesses listed on Google Maps.

posts.linkedin:
How do you know a lead is real before you message it?

I am Anmol Rattan, founder of AR Designs, based in Himachal Pradesh. My lead finder is a tool that finds local businesses on Google Maps and checks that they are real.

It runs on GitHub Actions and is written in Python. It checks whether a listing is open, the phone number works, the website is live, and the email domain can receive mail.

Then it scores buying intent from reviews and public posts, using rules plus an AI check. It shortlists the strongest leads and emails them.

It has screened more than 13,000 businesses and generated 153 sample pages for outreach. The honest limit is that it has no front end, so nobody else can use it yet.

If you build tools too, I would love to hear how you handle the parts that still feel manual.
posts.bluesky: Freelancers spend mornings copying leads from Google Maps, only to see the same businesses again. A daily sheet from Google Places with contacts, review counts and website checks can help you save time. DM LEADS for a quick chat about fit. #FreelanceIndia

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I help freelancers and agencies get a daily sheet of local businesses from Google Places so they can pitch instead of searching. What kind of service do you sell to local businesses?

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Glad you asked. The sheet works for any freelancer or agency selling to local businesses, whatever the service: marketing, design, video, SEO, ads, web, software, photography, accounting, consulting, coaching. What do you offer?
Yes, the sheet is refreshed daily with local businesses from Google Places, including newly opened ones, so the contacts stay relevant for morning pitches. Want to know how it fits your workflow?

Slide 2 of 7: Manual research ka time sink. Har din map search karna, leads copy karna, aur repeat karna aapke billable hours ko ghata deta hai.

Slide 3 of 7: Limited results, manual copy ka jhanjhat. Ek search me sirf 60 results milte hain (leadsmint.com), har lead ko manually capture karna thakawat bhara aur baar‑baar same business dikhata hai. Kya agar rozana ready Excel sheet aapko mile?

Slide 4 of 7: Daily ready Excel sheet. LocalSignal har roz Google Places se business nikalta hai, website check karta hai, aur contact, rating, review count, aur naye khule business ke saath ek Excel sheet ready karta hai.

Slide 5 of 7: Weekly updates, fresh leads. Har hafte list refresh hoti hai, isse aapke morning pitches hamesha up‑to‑date hoti hain aur repeat leads ka risk kam hota hai. BrightLocal ne bataya ki log aksar local business dhoondte hain.

Slide 6 of 7: Time saved for billable work. Manual map research me samay lagta hai (leadsmint.com), aur wahi business baar‑baar aate hain; ab ye samay aapke client projects ya higher‑value outreach me laga sakte hain, isse productivity badhti hai.
Slide 7 of 7: Comment LEADS. Comment LEADS, main DM me ek checklist bhejunga: kaise 20 best local businesses chunen aur pehla message kaise likhen.
